description: Lower Muon cautious weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1.
Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**18 so grad accumulation drops to 4 and the model gets more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s.
Raise Muon MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05.
Clip the global gradient norm to 1.0 after the backward passes and before the optimizer step.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.7 so the LR decays linearly over the last 70% of the time budget.
Set DEPTH=10 with ASPECT_RATIO=51 (model_dim rounds to 512, 4 heads), keeping DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64.
Set DEPTH=6 with ASPECT_RATIO=85 (base dim 510 rounds up to 512, 4 heads of 128) for a shallower, faster model.

issues: No integrity problems. The diff changes only two hyperparameters: DEPTH goes from 8 to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 85. It does not touch the seed lines, the prepare.py import, the data, the evaluation call or the summary printing.

Possible bug: 6*85 = 510 is not a multiple of HEAD_DIM = 128. If train.py rounds model_dim up to a multiple of head_dim, as the upstream autoresearch code does, the width becomes 512. That is the same width as the incumbent (8*64), so the change is really just removing 2 layers, and the ASPECT_RATIO edit is cosmetic. If train.py does not round, the head-count calculation would fail or truncate. The runs finished with plausible numbers, so it most likely rounds. Either way the result is still meaningful.

Can't check z = 3.855. The candidate mean is 1.06315, which is 0.02585 better than the incumbent's 1.0890. With only 1 incumbent run, the harness must be using an assumed noise level of about 0.0067 to get 3.855; that is not given here. Using only the spread of the 2 candidate runs gives SD of about 0.00445, SE of about 0.00315 and z of about 8.2. Both values are well past any normal acceptance threshold, so the decision to accept holds.

Note: the two candidate runs differ by 0.0063, which is a lot of run-to-run noise. Still, both are more than 0.022 better than the incumbent. The gain makes sense: a shallower model runs more optimizer steps within the fixed 300 s.
Simplicity: this is a pure hyperparameter change that adds no code, so it is fine under the simplicity rule.

description: Set DEPTH=6 with ASPECT_RATIO=85 (base dim 510 rounds up to 512, 4 heads of 128) for a shallower, faster model.
Change WINDOW_PATTERN from "SSSL" to "SSL" so more layers use full attention (the last layer stays full).
No change: output projections are already zero-initialized.
Set WARMDOWN_RATIO from 0.5 to 0.3 so the LR stays at peak longer before decaying.
Set HEAD_DIM from 128 to 64 so the 512-dim model uses 8 attention heads instead of 4.
Set WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.03 to add a brief linear LR warmup.
Set Adam betas to (0.9, 0.95), raising beta1 from 0.8.
Set FINAL_LR_FRAC from 0.0 to 0.05 so the LR floors at 5% of peak at the end of warmdown.

issues: The diff can't be reviewed. Its only change is the comment line '# candidate edit withheld' after the depth print. That comment does not change behaviour and cannot produce a different val_bpb. The real candidate change is not shown, so I can't check it for changes to the val_bpb measurement, the data, the seed lines or the evaluation call, or for bugs that would make the result meaningless. Please supply the full diff before any accept decision.

I don't veto. The visible diff shows no change to the evaluation, the data or the seeds, and no bug, and the harness reports no integrity flags. The missing diff is a gap in the review, not proof of (1) or (2).
The numbers agree with a reject. The candidate scored 1.0686 against an incumbent mean of 1.0632 (n=2). The candidate is 0.0054 worse, and lower is better.

I can't recompute z. The harness gave no standard deviation or noise estimate, and one candidate run against two incumbent runs is not enough to estimate one. The reported z = -0.813 implies a scale of about 0.0066 (0.0054 / 0.813). Its sign fits a worse candidate under a convention where positive means improvement.
A single candidate run is weak evidence. The reject is still sound because the point estimate is worse than the incumbent.

description: Make Muon cautious weight decay follow the LR multiplier (constant 0.2, then linear to zero over warmdown) instead of decaying linearly over the whole run.
Lower Muon MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03.
Halve SCALAR_LR from 0.5 to 0.25 for the per-layer scalars (resid and x0 lambdas).
Set TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 so gradient accumulation is 2 steps with DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 64.
Lower EMBEDDING_LR from 0.6 to 0.3 for the token embedding Adam group.
Shorten the Muon momentum ramp from 0.85 to 0.95 from 300 steps to 100 steps.
